program_name: Master of Science (Water and Hydropower Engineering)

requirements.general_text: Entry Level and Requirements For Local Students   Bachelor in Engineering (Honours) / Bachelor in Engineering Technology from Universiti Kuala Lumpur with minimum CGPA of 2.50 or equivalent; or Bachelor of Science (Honours) in related field with CGPA of 2.50 from any universities as approved by Senate, Universiti Kuala Lumpur; or Bachelor degree in related sciences or technical field with CGPA below than 2.50 is acceptable for admission subject to a minimum of 5 years relevance working experience as approved by Senate, Universiti Kuala Lumpur. For International Students Bachelor's in Engineering (Honours) / Engineering Technology from Universiti Kuala Lumpur with CGPA of 2.50; OR Bachelor's in a related field with CGPA of 2.50 from approved universities; OR CGPA below 2.50 may be accepted with 2 years of relevant work experience. IELTS 6.0-6.5, TOEFL 550 or equivalent.
